THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My Ref. No.: POL/ELH/LND/01/විවිධ/52. Lands Ministry Ref. No.: 4-3/2/2014/ WR/278. I hereby give public notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that land in the area described below is required for a public purpose and the Government is intending to acquire it. Description of the land intended for acquisition: The public purpose here is the acquisition of land for the Kirioya Elephant Pass Development Project. The allotment of land is mentioned in the Plan No. A.B.P. 25, Interim Plot No. 191, Sheet No. 202, prepared by the Surveyor General and shown as Lot No. 8696 in the Basic Plan dated 16.08.2023, which is situated in the village of Kirioya in the Grama Niladhari Division of 01 Kirioya

under the Elahera Divisional Secretariat in Polonnaruwa District in the North Central Province. 01. Lot No. 8696 Name of the land: Aththaragallewa Jungle; utilization of the land - Chena; Claimant: Government; Beneficiaries: Field boundaries were examined and identified. It was illegally cultivated by Medegedara Horathala, a resident of Devahena Road, Aththaragallewa. The land is necessary to install the Kirioya Elephant Pass Under the Moragahakanda Kalu Ganga Development Project; Extent of the land: 0.7038 Hectare. To North : Lot No. 8698, 6920 and 6921; To East : Lot No. 6921 and 8698; To South : Lot No. 8698; To West : Lot No. 8698.
